head.title: Slop Scorer: we remake the artifact and time ourselves doing it
head.description: We do not score you. We try to remake the artifact, time ourselves doing it, and show you every measurement that let us take the shortcut. Abstention is a result.

images.alt: A marketing landing page: a violet-to-blue gradient band, one very large bold headline, and a row of three identical bordered cards.
Recreation generated by Slop Scorer: the same layout rebuilt from the measurements listed below: the same gradient band, headline block and three-card row.

text.innerText: SLOP SCORER Method MCP plugin Our own receipt This page has already been scanned by the thing it sells. Not a score. We reproduce the artifact and show you how long it took. Below is the live result for this URL. Nothing is cached, and if a deploy breaks one of our own checks this is where you will find out. slop-scorer.vercel.app · scan_ui INCONCLUSIVE the run did not complete We could not scan ourselves just now. That is a result, and we are showing it rather than a cached one. Nothing on this page is a stored screenshot, which is exactly why it can fail in front of you. This is the same report any URL gets. We publish ours because a detector that cannot survive its own test is not worth running. Paste a URL, or drop an image Run it There is no queue behind this control yet, so it opens a worked example rather than scanning what you typed. We would rather tell you that than take an address and do nothing with it. The scan above this one is real and runs on every page load. We do not name creators. We do not assert that anything is AI. Read the method before you read a receipt. A real receipt, with the part our lawyer cares about visible before you sign up When an original and a recreation appear together, the disclaimer sits inside the same frame, at the same size as the panel labels. That is a legal requirement, not a styling preference, and it is on this page so you can check it before you give us anything. SUBMITTED submitted for this sample by us, 1024x640 GENERATED BY US just now, 8.4 s, prompt in the evidence below READ THIS WITH THE IMAGES ABOVE The right-hand panel was generated by us, moments ago, from the prompt listed in the evidence below. It is not evidence about who made the left-hand panel, or how they made it. We make no claim that any person used a generative model. What is shown is one fact only: this artifact is cheap to reproduce. Pipeline: layout transcription, then a single render pass. No model in the scoring path. The prompt is carried as evidence on css.violet-blue-gradient below. Read the whole receipt, including what we could not assess The other half is prevention The same corpus is exposed to your own coding agent over MCP, so it can ask what not to produce before it produces it. Detection decays as generators improve. A rule that stops the artifact being made does not. The server lives in this repository at packages/mcp-server. There is no hosted install command yet, and there will not be a copy button here until there is something real to copy. What this cannot see 39 rules is not a verdict on taste. The scan in the fold reads hygiene and rendered style on one page at one viewport. It cannot read motion, audio, typography inside an image, or whether the writing is any good. A clean run means the checks that ran found nothing they know how to cite, and nothing more than that. The method, in full, including the parts that argue against us Built by one person who got tired of arguing about whether something was made by a machine, and decided to measure how long it takes to remake it instead. We do not name creators. We do not assert that anything is AI. Read the method before you read a receipt. The method, and what it cannot see

probes.note: elements sampled for computed styles. Zero means the `body *` walk returned nothing and every CSS rule below it passed having measured nothing.
@font-face rules enumerated from same-origin stylesheets. Zero is legitimate (a system-font page), so this probe does not demand a non-empty result.

script responses captured. Zero means the response filter went stale and the source-map, bundle-weight and vendor-host rules all passed having scanned nothing. This is the exact bug the source corpus shipped for months.
words of rendered innerText. Zero means the page rendered nothing readable.
